I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
knob:
- 7.64 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.
nut_fit_coupon:
- 7.64 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

I’ll resend it unchanged because the fit result is still unknown. The hex socket is 8.30 mm across flats; the narrower gap between the retaining lips is 7.60 mm. Please print the coupon first and check that the nut presses in by hand and stays captured upside down.

{"note":"Unchanged fit geometry: 8.30 mm across-flats hex socket, 7.60 mm relaxed gap between retaining lips. The reported 7.64 mm pocket result did not establish fit, so no fit adjustment has been made. Print the coupon first. Finished assembly uses one printed knob and one M5 nut; the coupon is only a test print. Catalog-based, unverified fit; intended for light hand tightening at room temperature.","params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"ISO 4032 M5 nominal AF; actual nut unmeasured."},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":18,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_t":{"value":2.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"socket_af_clearance":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Total AF clearance, giving 8.30 mm socket."},"bolt_clearance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Diametral clearance, giving 5.60 mm hole."},"nut_axial_play":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"latch_ramp_h":{"value":1.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"latch_projection":{"value":0.35,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Each lip projects inward from socket flat. Relaxed lip gap 7.60 mm."},"tab_t":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_w":{"value":3.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_side_gap":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"tab_back_gap":{"value":1.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_count":{"value":8,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cutter_r":{"value":3.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cutter_offset":{"value":17,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Radial location of scallop cutter centres."}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    af = p.nut_af + p.socket_af_clearance
    a = af/2
    z_lip = p.floor_t + p.nut_h + p.nut_axial_play
    height = z_lip + p.latch_ramp_h
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(height)
    for i in range(int(p.grip_count)):
        ang = 2*math.pi*i/p.grip_count
        cutter = cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.grip_cutter_offset*math.cos(ang),p.grip_cutter_offset*math.sin(ang)).circle(p.grip_cutter_r).extrude(height)
        body = body.cut(cutter)
    r = af/math.sqrt(3)
    verts = [(r*math.cos(i*math.pi/3),r*math.sin(i*math.pi/3)) for i in range(6)]
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY',origin=(0,0,p.floor_t)).polyline(verts).close().extrude(height))
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance)/2).extrude(height))
    ww = p.tab_w+2*p.tab_side_gap
    wd = p.tab_t+p.tab_back_gap
    for s in (-1,1):
        window = cq.Workplane('XY').box(ww,wd,height-p.floor_t,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,s*(a+wd/2),p.floor_t))
        body = body.cut(window)
    for s in (-1,1):
        tab = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.tab_w,p.tab_t,height-p.floor_t,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((0,s*(a+p.tab_t/2),p.floor_t))
        points = [(s*a,z_lip),(s*(a-p.latch_projection),z_lip),(s*a,height)]
        lip = cq.Workplane('YZ',origin=(-p.tab_w/2,0,0)).polyline(points).close().extrude(p.tab_w)
        body = body.union(tab).union(lip)
    return body.clean()

Slight angular play is acceptable."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Print nut_fit_coupon first, using PLA, 0.2 mm layers, at least 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers and 30% infill. Use the supplied orientation, without supports. Check slicer preview for two intact 0.8 mm tabs and open relief gaps.","parts":["nut_fit_coupon"],"tool":"Slicer"},{"n":"2","text":"Cool fully and remove strings from the pocket and relief gaps without thinning the tabs. Align the nut flats with the socket. On a flat table, press the nut straight in with your thumb until it rests on the bottom shoulder and both tabs return inward. Stop if excessive force is needed; do not hammer.","parts":["nut_fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"3","text":"Check hand insertion, upside-down retention with no bolt installed, fully recessed seating, the bottom stop, anti-rotation and through-bolt passage. Fit remains unverified until these tests pass. If the lips are too tight, reduce latch_projection by 0.05 mm and reprint the coupon. If fixed socket walls bind, increase socket_af_clearance by 0.1 mm and retest. If retention fails, increase latch_projection by 0.05 mm and retest. Changes must also be used for the final knob. Discard cracked or whitened prints.","parts":["nut_fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"4","text":"To recover the nut from the coupon, gently flex both tabs outward while pushing the nut upward through the bottom hole with a small blunt rod narrower than the hole. Keep fingers out of the rod's path. Avoid repeated insertion/removal; the PLA snaps are intended primarily for one-time installation.","parts":["nut_fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"],"tool":"Small blunt rod"},{"n":"5","text":"After the coupon passes, print knob with the same tested parameters and settings, opening upward. Cool, clean and hand-press the nut in. Repeat retention and bolt-passage checks. Only knob and nut are used in the finished assembly; no glue or additional retainer.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"6","text":"Use as a captive-nut knob on your M5 bolt. The bolt can emerge from the other side through the central hole. Tighten by hand only; do not use pliers, power tools or a lever. Stop if plastic cracks or the nut slips. Keep away from heat and inspect before use.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}]}
